G3.note: Scale confirmed by SEAB (G3 adopts the O-Level grading structure; GCE O-Level is treated as equivalent to G3 by MOE). Points = grade number is the long-standing O-Level aggregate convention; no SEC page restating the point values was seen, so treat the points column as provisional-by-convention. Certificate award: E8 or better at G3.

G2.note: Scale confirmed (G2 adopts N(A)-Level structure; N(A) treated as equivalent to G2). Points = grade number in ELMAB3 (ITE 2-year page computes aggregate from G2-equivalent grades directly). Certificate award: grade 5 or better. Grade 6 counts in ITE aggregates but cannot meet MERs.

G1.note: Points are the ITE aggregate points in the MOE 3-Year Higher Nitec mapping table. Certificate award: grade D or better. G1 E usable in ITE aggregate but not to meet MERs.

g2_in_g3_aggregate.rule: No G2-to-G3 up-mapping is published. Instead, mixed aggregates are computed in G2-equivalent points for the slot(s) allowed at G2. In ELR2B2 (poly, 2028+), EL, R1, R2 and B1 use the G3 grade (points 1-9 but 9 unusable); B2 ALWAYS uses a G2-equivalent grade: a G2 subject contributes its G2 grade (1-4 usable), a G3 subject in the B2 slot is mapped down with g3_to_g2_equivalent. G3 grade 9 and G2 grades 5 and 6 cannot be used in ELR2B2.
g2_in_g3_aggregate.l1r4: Not allowed: all L1R4 subjects (JC and MI) must be taken at G3.
g2_in_g3_aggregate.arts_lasalle: LASALLE 2028+: 4 non-English subjects, one may be G2; if all four are G3, the lowest-grade one is mapped G3->G2. Same shape as ELR2B2 R2B2 part.

mapping.same_subject_two_levels: If the same subject was taken at two levels, both are mapped and the better equivalent grade is used (ITE pages).

usability.ELR2B2: G3 9 and G2 5/6 cannot be used.
usability.PFP_ELMAB3: G3 9 and G2 5/6 cannot be used.

usability.Sec5_G2_aggregates: At least grade 5 at G2 (equivalent) for every subject used.

mapping.note: G3->G2 table appears identically on MOE poly, PFP, ITE 2-year pages and SEAB; MOE worked example: G3 B4 -> G2 2. G3->G1 is the composition of the two published tables (provisional for the composed form; the MOE 3-Year page shows the same bands per search extract).

L1R4.what: First language + 4 relevant subjects, gross aggregate; net = gross - bonus points (net used for posting).
subjectsCounted: L1: G3 English Language or G3 Higher MTL (if HMTL is L1, the corresponding MTL cannot also be an R subject)
R2: a Mathematics or Science subject (G3)
R3: a Humanities, Mathematics or Science subject (G3)
R4: any best remaining G3 subject

ELR2B2.what: EL + 2 relevant subjects (R1, R2, defined by course aggregate type A-D) + 2 best other subjects (B1, B2); net = gross - CCA bonus points.
subjectsCounted: B2 (G2-equivalent grade; may be a G2 subject, or a G3 subject mapped down)
ELR2B2.note: Hence 4 subjects must be G3 (EL, R1, R2, B1). The max contribution of B2 drops from ~8 (old O-Level) to 4, which is why the cut-off moved from 26 to 22.

ELMAB3.what: EL + Mathematics/Additional Mathematics + 3 best other subjects, all at G2-equivalent grades; gross (no bonus).
ELMAB3.note: One search extract of the PFP page glossed B1/B3 as '1st and 3rd best-scoring subject'; the ITE 2-year page states '3 Best Subjects (B1, B2 and B3)'. Treat as EL + MA + 3 best subjects. Used by PFP (<=12), ITE 2-year Higher Nitec (<=19), Sec 5 (<=21) and Sec 5 all-G3 option (<=19).

changes_since_2026_08_05.text: No new MOE press release, Parliamentary reply or SEAB notice changing PSE 2028 rules was found dated after 2026-08-05. MOE pages still say 2028-specific course information (CourseFinder MERs, aggregate-type lists) will be updated in mid-2027.

Corrections to app data found during verification (not new announcements): (1) poly B2 slot is always at G2-equivalent, not 'one of the two best may be G2'; (2) 22/24 are NET (after CCA) poly cut-offs; (3) JC/MI bonus cap is 3 (+2 LEP); (4) JC MTL can be G2 (1-5) or G1 (A-D); (5) ELR2B2 has 4 types A-D, no -E, and the app's family labels are wrong; (6) 3-year Higher Nitec uses G1-equivalent aggregate types, not G2; (7) G3 9 / G2 5-6 unusable in ELR2B2 and PFP ELMAB3 but usable in ITE aggregates.
Secondary explainers published Oct 2026 (edukatesg 6 Oct and 24 Oct 2026) restate the same rules; no changes.
